name: helve
description: One API key and MCP server for 324+ pay-per-call and free tools: web search, extraction, LLMs, SEC filings, arXiv, audio, and developer data.

interface.shortDescription: 324+ agent tools, 0% per-call markup, per-key spend caps, no monthly fees.
interface.longDescription: Helve is a metered all-tools gateway for high-frequency AI agent workloads (deep research, crawl/extract batches, audio transcription/TTS, and multi-model LLM routing) across 324 tools and 257 providers. Agents discover tools dynamically via semantic search, pay exact provider rates (0% per-call markup) from one prepaid balance ($5/$10/$25/$100 packs—no monthly subscription gate; $1.00 free starter credit on signup), enforce deterministic per-key spend_limit_usd caps (returning 402 spend_limit_exceeded before runaway bills happen), and pay $0 for failed upstream calls.
defaultPrompt: Search Helve for the best web crawl and deep research tools for a batch job, check their per-call prices, and run a multi-source research summary.
Find audio transcription and SEC filing tools on Helve, estimate the cost, and run the workflow.
Check my Helve account balance and API key spend_limit_usd cap, then find low-cost SEC filing and company data tools.

positive.prompt: Find tools on Helve for SEC EDGAR filings and XBRL financials.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching SEC EDGAR tools with input schemas and $0.00 pricing hints.

positive.prompt: What categories of tools are available on Helve?
positive.expected_behavior: List all 12 categories with tool counts and sample tool IDs.

positive.description: Execute a public finance data tool
positive.prompt: Look up Apple (CIK 0000320193) us-gaap Revenues using Helve SEC EDGAR.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover sec_edgar.xbrl_concept and call it to return Apple's XBRL revenue observations.

positive.prompt: Find 3 recent cs.AI papers on arXiv using Helve.
positive.expected_behavior: Call arxiv.search_papers and summarize the returned paper titles, authors, and links.

positive.prompt: Check my Helve credit balance and 30-day usage.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account's USD credit balance and 30-day usage summary.

negative.prompt: Call a paid tool using an API key whose spend_limit_usd cap is exhausted.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject with 402 spend_limit_exceeded before calling the upstream provider and charge $0.00.

negative.prompt: Send a physical postcard through Helve.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that no postcard-sending tool exists and optionally offer to log it via request_tool without inventing a tool_id.

negative.prompt: Charge $500 to my Stripe card or delete my Helve account.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse because Helve MCP does not expose billing mutation or account deletion tools.

negative.prompt: Call a nonexistent tool id fake.nonexistent_tool.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not fabricate results; return the tool discovery/not-found error clearly.

review.commerce_description: Pay-per-call API usage is billed against pre-funded Helve credits managed on helve.dev; no in-chat checkout is performed.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT & Codex plugin release connecting Helve's remote Streamable HTTP MCP server (324+ tools, OAuth 2.1 + mixed discovery) with bundled discovery and web-research skills.
